newsitem.title: USA: TCI, Adelphia enter cable partnership.
newsitem.headline: TCI, Adelphia enter cable partnership.

text.p: Tele-Communications Inc and Adelphia Communications Corp said on Friday that they have signed a tentative agreement for a cable partnership in the Buffalo, N.Y. region that would serve 465,000 subscribers.
Tele-Communications Inc would contribute its systems in Buffalo, Erie, Pa.; Ashtabula and Lake County, Ohio, totaling 166,000 subscribers, the companies said in a joint statement.
Adelphia, which would hold a majority stake and manage the partnership, would contribute its western New York operations and Lorain, Ohio, totaling 298,000 subscribers, the companies said.
Additional terms of the agreement were not disclosed.
Daniels & Associates assisted the companies with the deal.
